newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian miner dies after explosion. [corrected 10:00 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian miner dies after explosion. [corrected 10:00 gmt]

text.p: One of 11 miners injured in an explosion at Bulgaria's Bobov Dol coal mine on Monday has died from burns and methane gas poisoning, an Energy Committee official said on Thursday.
Lyuba Manolova, assistant to the committee chairman, told Reuters three more miners remained in critical condition.

The Bulgarian government on Tuesday sacked the management of the Bobov Dol mine, 70 km (42 miles) west of Sofia, following the explosion which occurred when a ventilator was switched on after a power cut.
Deputy Prime Minister Evgeni Bakardzhiev said the mine's safety record was unacceptable as more than 20 miners had died in accidents in the past seven or eight years.
(Corrects attribution from Industry Minister Alexander Bozhkov)
